I have submited an application as new patient on Friday the 29 th of June and I was advised someone will get in touch in 7 to 10 days.
I specifically mentioned at the reception that I have a heart condition and I have moved recently and I have pills left for a week. No one contacted me until today the 21 st of July.
I called before on the 12 th and spoke to someone and I told them I need a doctor appointment to check my condition and I was told it will be done. On the 13 th I received a letter in which I was informed a New Patient telephone appointment has been arranged for the 21 St.
I was expecting a call from a doctor due to the fact that I have mentioned my condition twice already but a lady from the pharmacy called to check the prescription. She was very nice and said she can book an appointment for me. I don't think that there is any chance I can see a doctor in this practice.
As I don't believe that NHS is interested in helping the patient at all. I'm making this statement due to the fact that in January I have requested a heart scan as I didn't had any since January 2022 and also a head scan as I was having difficulty in concentrating and dizziness on a daily basis and I was told it will take 4 to 8 weeks but it's been 7 months now and nothing happened. I expect your reply as now I don't take my medication anymore as no one supplied and secondly part of it was making me feel very bad.",null,[0,167]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKOVp1bklBEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x952b1f86ef675f9f!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDJ9ZunIA%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKOVp1bklBEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKOVp1bklBEi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJREo5WnVub0FFEhNDZ3dJMVBMcXBRWVEtT2lBNmdFGi0KFkNJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJREo5WnVuWUESE0Nnd0kxUExxcFFZUS1PaUE2Z0UiEgkAAAAAAAAAABGfX2fvhh8rlSoTQ2d3STFQTHFwUVlRLU9pQTZnRQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiBievXorCTAxXtTIQGHVDhAwEQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiBievXorCTAxXtTIQGHVDhAwEQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURVpLTkVaZlgxOWZSV2hEZERoR2VGOHdZVWgzUW5SV1VERjBUVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVE5DVVVOa2IyRmpSR1pWV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURHLXFMcjBRRRAB",["0x0:0x952b1f86ef675f9f",null,1637853365646424,1637853365646424,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114250965875446718537/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["G Camel","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVlRoYa2B6_ezq6vN6b2Uis0kTXDyHf08GwY9TJXSDlq9pawDVm=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114250965875446718537?hl=en"],"114250965875446718537",null,2,0,null,[0,2,1],1,["2 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiBievXorCTAxXtTIQGHVDhAwEQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"4 years ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["A great practice with good friendly doctors that very much prioritise patient care and dignity.

very disappointing experience. I have submited an application as new patient on Friday the 29 th of June and I was advised someone will get in touch in 7 to 10 days.
I specifically mentioned at the reception that I have a heart condition and I have moved recently and I have pills left for a week. No one contacted me until today the 21 st of July.
I called before on the 12 th and spoke to someone and I told them I need a doctor appointment to check my condition and I was told it will be done. On the 13 th I received a letter in which I was informed a New Patient telephone appointment has been arranged for the 21 St.
I was expecting a call from a doctor due to the fact that I have mentioned my condition twice already but a lady from the pharmacy called to check the prescription. She was very nice and said she can book an appointment for me. I don't think that there is any chance I can see a doctor in this practice.
As I don't believe that NHS is interested in helping the patient at all. I'm making this statement due to the fact that in January I have requested a heart scan as I didn't had any since January 2022 and also a head scan as I was having difficulty in concentrating and dizziness on a daily basis and I was told it will take 4 to 8 weeks but it's been 7 months now and nothing happened. I expect your reply as now I don't take my medication anymore as no one supplied and secondly part of it was making me feel very
